candidates.name: Ormerath
candidates.feel: Stately and slow, like a crown set on an old map; it sounds like a kingdom remembering better days.

candidates.name: Veyl Marrow
candidates.feel: Hushed and bone-deep, a name for fen mist and buried salt, with a hard grey edge underneath.

candidates.name: Ishrel
candidates.feel: Short and sharp, like a struck bell; easy to shout across a marsh or a caravan camp.

candidates.name: Caldrane
candidates.feel: Cinder-rough and hard-edged, a name that rasps like cooling stone and hints at volcanic highlands.

candidates.name: Senneth
candidates.feel: Soft and sun-warm, like a word spoken over sand; it suggests wide, wind-scoured trade roads.

candidates.name: Gorth Wold
candidates.feel: Blunt and weathered, like a boundary stone; it suggests a tough forest country where folk guard their own.
